cases.user_message:
Synthetic stress report on Streamlit 1.64.0 and Python 3.13 on Linux with Chromium. In the supplied minimal app, selecting B in pick_0 repeatedly leaves the frontend at B while the next printed st.session_state["pick_0"] is A. I checked the browser console and observed no errors. Exact reproduction:
```python
import streamlit as st
def mark(key):
    st.session_state["last"] = (key, st.session_state[key])
for i in range(2):
    key = f"pick_{i}"
    st.selectbox(key, ["A", "B"], key=key, on_change=mark, args=(key,))
st.write(st.session_state)
```
